findings.description: Direct inspection of the eleven V147 renders shows the new front-coverage cloth component still loses coverage in crouch/sit and lifts away in prone. The shared edges remain visibly discontinuous in the posed renders, so the panel solve does not provide a controlled skirt/coverage transition. Reject pose coverage and deformation.

Neutral front and three-quarter renders show the separate front panels badly crumpled and obscure their intended pleats; the back and side remain a broad, near-conical/wedge shell with a straight, hard hem. The split component makes the skirt silhouette less coherent rather than controlling the shared hem.

The horizontal shelf at the waist-to-hip join and angular triangular artifacts along both torso sides remain visible in front, side, three-quarter, and posed views. These defects are independent of the skirt panel solve and still block appearance acceptance.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. V147's separately simulated front panels crumple in neutral poses while crouch/sit coverage and prone continuity still fail. Before another review, trace the shared seam vertices through the cloth split, skin transfer and posed render, then repair the front-panel-to-shell joining path so coverage follows the thigh motion without losing the controlled hem. Fit, weights, UV, Unity, VRChat and release remain independent gates.
